title: Covalently silane-bridged e-graphene oxide nanosheets toward year-long dispersion-stable epoxy nanocomposites with superior corrosion protection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27818-27836
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02282K, Paper
Open Access

Anh-Tuan Pham, Quan-Doan Mai, Ngo Thi Loan, Nguyen Thai Huy, Ngo Thi Phuong Anh, Pham Cong Thanh, Nguyen Thi Trang, Le Minh Quang, Nguyen Van Quyet, Ta Ngoc Bach, Anh-Tuan Le
In this work, we establish a covalent silane-bridging (CSB) strategy to improve compatibility between electrochemically synthesized graphene oxide (e-GO) and epoxy, enabling stable dispersion with enhanced mechanical and corrosion resistance.
